title: Choose a Request Identity Key
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Choose a Request Identity Key.

concepts_covered: A limiter needs a key to decide which requests share a bucket; trusting proxy headers changes who can choose that key.
KeyFor prefers X-API-Key, then RemoteAddr; first X-Forwarded-For is used only when TrustedProxies is true.
